caption: The drawing shows a small, rounded pottery object placed in the center of a plain, light beige background. The pottery has a gourd-like shape, with a wider base and a narrow neck, and features two protruding elements at the upper section—one larger vertical form resembling a head and a smaller horizontal form resembling a tail. The surface of the pottery is decorated with a dark brown color as the main background, and is covered with a pattern of white dots and curved lines, forming arcs and spotted designs. The head and tail areas of the object are a reddish-brown color, while the rest is primarily dark brown. There is a handwritten name, “aava Fastoway,” in cursive in the lower left part of the image. The drawing is minimalistic, with the decorated pottery as the primary focus on an otherwise empty background.
title: Earthenware Bird
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
